{{Top|leg}}
A '''ticket-chip''' was an electronic device used by passengers to legally board [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. They were coin-sized [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] [[Datachip/Legends|datachips]] which had personal information encoded on them including the holder's height, weight, and date of birth, and their scheduled trip. They were read by [[Ticket-chip scanner|scanners]] at transportation gates, and by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Customs official/Legends|customs officials]] with a hand-held version.
